verdict.rationale: Keycloak is self-hosted, open-source software that can be deployed to any datacenter, cloud region, or on-prem environment (docker run, Kubernetes/OpenShift Operator, PostgreSQL backend), which inherently gives operators full control over where identity data physically resides. However, there is no explicit documentation or feature addressing data residency/region selection as a first-class concept (e.g., multi-region replication, region-pinning, compliance certifications for specific jurisdictions). Missing for 10: explicit residency/region documentation, data locality guarantees, compliance mapping (e.g., GDPR region controls), and any first-party guidance on residency configuration beyond generic self-hosting.
